question_text: What will PayPal Holdings, Inc. say during their next earnings call?
resolution_criteria:
If Stablecoin / Stable Coin is said by any PayPal Holdings, Inc. representative (including the operator of the call) during the next PayPal Holdings, Inc. earnings call (including the Q+A), then the market resolves to Yes.
Video of the PayPal Holdings, Inc. earnings call will be primarily used to resolve the market; if a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, transcripts of the PayPal Holdings, Inc. earnings call will be used according to the news publications listed in the contract. The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word, must be used. Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. Please see full rules for more details.
